name: com.voyageforge.depot
description: Voyage Depot is a shared utility stockroom for Unity projects, collecting reusable runtime helpers, editor tooling, and common extensions.

samples.description: Shows foreground keep-alive service, battery optimization whitelist, and alive duration calls.
Demonstrates Newtonsoft.Json Vector3Converter for serializing/deserializing Unity Vector3.
Provides URP shaders including AnimatedSpriteSheet and CommonUI template.
Demonstrates initializing the runtime console from a [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod] and waking it with a triple Tab press.
